title: Anchor: Preventing Artifact Drift for Reliable Agent Verification
abstract: arXiv:2605.26321v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reliable evaluation of long-horizon agents requires verifiers that match what the task actually asks. Verifiable rewards have driven progress in domains like math and coding, yet building similarly reliable environments for open-ended enterprise workflows repeatedly struggles to balance realism, verifiability, and scale. This creates a validity problem we call artifact drift: when instructions, environments, oracles, and verifiers are created separately, they frequently fail to agree on what a task requires, resulting in environments that are unsolvable, reward-hackable, or inconsistent. We introduce Anchor, a benchmark-construction pipeline that formalizes domain expert specifications of business workflows into constrained optimization programs. From a single parametric specification, the pipeline jointly produces a natural-language instruction, environment configuration, solver-certified ground-truth solution, and state-based verif

translated_title: Anchor：防止工件漂移以实现可靠的智能体验证
translated_abstract: 对长程智能体的可靠评估需要与任务实际要求相匹配的验证器。可验证奖励推动了数学和编程等领域的进展，然而为开放式企业工作流构建同样可靠的环境时，往往难以在真实性、可验证性和规模之间取得平衡。这带来了一个我们称之为“工件漂移”的有效性问题：当指令、环境、标准答案和验证器各自独立创建时，它们常常无法就任务的实际要求达成一致，导致环境不可求解、可被奖励作弊或彼此不一致。我们提出 Anchor，这是一个基准构建流水线，它将领域专家对业务工作流的规范形式化为约束优化程序。基于单一参数化规范，该流水线联合生成自然语言指令、环境配置、经求解器认证的真实解以及基于状态的验证器。
tldr: 该论文提出 Anchor 基准构建流水线，通过将领域专家的业务工作流规范形式化为约束优化程序，从单一参数化规范联合生成相互一致的自然语言指令、环境配置、经求解器认证的真实解和基于状态的验证器，从而防止各任务组件不一致导致的“工件漂移”问题，实现可靠的智能体验证。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Anchor, a benchmark-construction pipeline that formalizes domain expert specifications of business workflows into constrained optimization programs, jointly producing consistent instructions, environment configurations, solver-certified ground-truth solutions, and state-based verifiers from a single parametric specification to prevent artifact drift for reliable agent verification.
